messages:
Evelyn (People Ops): Heads-up: Year-end maintenance week Dec 28-30. All hubs will have limited access while we do HVAC, deep-clean, and network firmware upgrades. Please read details and action items below, RSVP for on-site days by Dec 15.

Samir (Eng): Will any hubs be fully closed? Im flying in from out of town.

Evelyn (People Ops): No full-day mandatory closures, but SF and LON will have restricted floors each day. If you need guaranteed desk space, reserve through DeskReserve — weve opened 7-day windows for this week only.

Hannah (Facilities): Important: hardware returns and shipping. Any loaner GPUs, monitors, or dongles in your possession must be logged and returned to Facilities by Dec 20. Use the asset portal and drop-off labeled "YearEndRMA" at reception. Unreturned items may block future hardware requests.

Theo (IT): VPN certificate rotation happens Dec 29 00:00-02:00 PT. If you rely on long-running jobs, please checkpoint before midnight. We will announce the short maintenance window in the #eng-infra channel.

FacilitiesBot: Shuttle adjustments for the week:
```
Dec 28 (Thu): 07:15 / 08:00 / 17:00 / 18:00 (limited to 18 pax)
Dec 29 (Fri): 07:30 / 08:30 / 16:30 / 18:30 (reduced evening runs)
Dec 30 (Sat): 09:00 single run to downtown (reserve required)
```
Book via DeskReserve -> "Year-end Shuttle" tag.

Evelyn (People Ops): Coworking stipend: if you cannot work from home and want a nearby coworking space, we will reimburse up to $25/day for Dec 28-30 with receipts. Fill the expense form and tag "coworking-stipend". This is intended for those in transit, regional hubs with restrictions, or family obligations that make the office impractical.

Samir (Eng): Do guests/partners get badges during the maintenance week?

Hannah (Facilities): External guests are discouraged due to contractors on-site. If you must host a visitor, get express approval from People Ops and submit a visitor request by Dec 20. All visitors must wear a visitor lanyard and be escorted.

Theo (IT): Reminder: if youre planning to ship equipment over the holidays, coordinate with Shipping Ops by Dec 18. FedEx/UPS pickups may be limited after Dec 22.

Evelyn (People Ops): Accessibility & exceptions: if you need a ground-floor desk, parking, or have medical equipment needs during the maintenance window, DM People Ops by Dec 12 and well reserve an appropriate workspace.

Samir (Eng): Any change to the holiday time-off policy? My team thought about taking the 29th off.

Evelyn (People Ops): Holiday PTO policy unchanged. Dec 25 is a company holiday; Dec 28-30 are regular workdays but were offering more flexibility (coworking stipend, hybrid reservations). Managers: be flexible with teams and log exceptions on the People Ops portal.

CalendarBot: Event created "Year-end Maintenance Week - Dec 28-30" by Evelyn. RSVP required: https://intranet.redwood/office-events/1789000123

Evelyn (People Ops): TL;DR: Dec 28-30 limited office access for deep-clean and upgrades, reserve desks on DeskReserve, return loaner hardware by Dec 20, VPN rotation Dec 29 00:00-02:00 PT, coworking stipend $25/day with receipts, guests discouraged. Ping People Ops or Facilities with special needs. :wrench: :sparkles:
